validity.researcher_notes: Recorded PipelineType='distribution' is likely wrong. Every source uniformly calls this object a 'газопровод-отвод' (a trunk-side feeder/branch pipeline) running FROM a tap point on the high-pressure 'Gryazovets-Leningrad' trunk TO the gas-distribution station (GRS) 'Ustyuzhna' -- i.e. it terminates AT the GRS, which is the standard transmission/distribution boundary in Russian gas infrastructure. Design pressure is 5.4 MPa (high-pressure transmission range). Critically, the Nov 2024 vologda-poisk.ru article explicitly lists THIS отвод (64.7 km) as a SEPARATE line item from the genuinely downstream distribution builds at the same site: 'межпоселковый газопровод ГРС Устюжна - г. Устюжна (10,8 км)' and 'распределительные газопроводы г. Устюжна - 1 этап (15 км)' -- meaning GEM may have conflated the отвод with (or mislabeled it as) the downstream distribution network, which is a distinct, separate infrastructure item outside this row's recorded length. Recommend reclassifying PipelineType to transmission.

THREE separate spec issues on this row, combined here because the shard's validity key only allows one 'spec' record per segment (segment_name='').

(1) LENGTH -- material disagreement, corrected value proposed. GEM's recorded LengthKnown=80.10 km is too high. Two independent sources 11 years apart converge on ~65 km specifically for the отвод to GRS 'Устюжна': the 2013 federal decree N1416-r states 'Протяженность газопровода-отвода к газораспределительной станции Устюжна должна составить 66,25 км', and a 2024-11-27 Vologda Oblast government dept-head quote (Vologda-Poisk) gives an exact current figure: 'газопровод отвода к г. Устюжна (64,7 км)'. The recorded 80.10 km is close to the 2013 decree's COMBINED total for Ustyuzhna (66.25 km) PLUS its separate Dubrovka branch (16.67 km) = 82.92 km -- GEM's row may have inherited a combined/wider-scope figure rather than the length of the object as it is actually titled and located (tap point near Shiryevo -> Ustyuzhna only, excluding the Dubrovka branch). Recommend correcting LengthKnown to 64.70 km (staged as the Length [ref] fill, class_out=REFS_ADDED) unless Baird confirms GEM intends the combined Ustyuzhna+Dubrovka scope.

(2) PROPOSALYEAR -- convention question, no replacement value proposed. GEM's recorded ProposalYear=2021 is defensible as 'the object's current programme-cycle label' per gazprommap.ru's 2021-2025 Vologda gasification programme and a 2023 actualization article (staged as the Proposal [ref] fill under that reading, REFS_ADDED). However this exact object was already a formally proposed federal project at least 8 years earlier: Правительство РФ Распоряжение N1416-р, dated 2013-08-13, names it (as item VII in that scheme) with planned 2014 construction start that evidently slipped. If GEM's ProposalYear convention means first-ever formal proposal rather than current-cycle inclusion, 2021 undercounts by ~8 years. Flagging for Baird's ruling on which convention applies.

(3) DIAMETER -- unconfirmed, conflicting single source, no replacement value proposed. GEM's recorded Diameter=300mm is not confirmed by any document read. The only document stating a diameter for this object conflicts with it: the 2013 decree N1416-r states 'Диаметр труб составит 350 мм' (350mm), but that decree was itself repealed/superseded by 816-r (2015), and no later document (the live 816-r item text, gazprommap.ru, the 2022 AGRS press release, or either 2024 Vologda construction-start article) restates a diameter figure at all. Not proposing a replacement since only one (superseded) source states any figure and it conflicts with the recorded one; flagging so a researcher with the current design documentation (Glavgosexpertiza approval or the AO Gazstroyprom contract) can settle 300mm vs 350mm vs something else.
